From the reflection, with \(a=44\), we have
\[
n=1973-b,\qquad -52<b\le 37.
\]
Since \(b=\left\lfloor\sqrt{\sqrt n}\right\rfloor\) is a nonnegative integer,
\[
0\le b\le 37.
\]
Now enforce
\[
b^4\le n=1973-b<(b+1)^4.
\]
For \(b\ge 7\), \(b^4\ge 2401>1973-b\), impossible.
For \(b\le 5\), \((b+1)^4\le 6^4=1296<1973-b\), impossible.
Thus the only possible value is
\[
b=6.
\]
Then
\[
n=1973-6=1967.
\]
Check:
\[
\sqrt{1967}\approx 44.35,\quad \sqrt{\sqrt{1967}}\approx 6.66,
\]
so
\[
1967+44+6=2017.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\boxed{1967}
\]
